message: cannot move `v`: it has a live `&` borrow

related.label: move here
`&` borrow of `v` by the thread spawned here: it may use `v` until the scope is left

fix.description: move `v` after the `scope` that runs the thread: its threads are joined only where it is left, so a `scope` around an endless loop never ends the borrow (open the `scope` inside the loop body instead)
